title: Litecoin (LTC): Good Trading Opportunity Opening | Bullish CME
description:
LTC is back on our radar, with good upside movement potential here, which starts with the current BOS that we might be forming. Aiming for that bullish CME first, then more.

More in-depth info is in the video—enjoy!
